Real type climbs ~170 KIAS and cruises ~300 KTAS / M0.50. finalApproachSpeed is intentionally left to FAA ACD (Vref 87). Validated by aviation-sim-expert against type performance.
Main-gear width corrected from the FAA ACD's anomalous 12.8 ft to the BE36's 9.6 ft, the same landing gear. Source: FAA ACD BE36 row.

The MD81's base profile carries no landing distance (0), so every runway counted as landable for it. Set to the MD82's 5,200 ft landing distance, the same airframe and the closest sourced figure. Source: AircraftProfiles.json MD82 row. Validated by aviation-sim-expert.
